stations.title: Theo
stations.say: Does this order ship free today?
stations.note: He checks the rules by eye.

stations.title: Packing table
stations.text: A yes or a no for every rule.

captions: Labels are tidy. Now Theo wants his shop rules answered for every order.
He checks free shipping, stock and gift notes by eye, and misses some.
You turn each rule into true or false, in four small tasks.
Now every rule gives a plain yes or no for today's order.
Comparisons with and, or and not: the rules work the same way every time.
